# WORK FLOW

- Import data

- Edit data

- Visualize

- Export

# DATA

Table data: `{r} fs::path_rel(in1)`

Polygon directory: `{r} fs::path_rel(in2)`

Output directory: `{r} fs::path_rel(dir_out)`



# Import

```{r}

# ============================================== #
# table data
studyarea <- readxl::read_xlsx(in1, sheet = "20261103_studyarea")

studyarea2 <- studyarea %>% 
  select(-index) %>%
  filter(memo == "use")



# ============================================== #
# import polygon

# list all shapefiles
shp_files <- list.files(
  in2,
  pattern = "\\.shp$",
  full.names = TRUE, 
  recursive = FALSE
)


# view file names
basename(shp_files)

# read all shapefiles
shp_list <- shp_files |>
  setNames(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(shp_files))) |>
  map(read_sf)



# ============================================== #
# import cleaned reviewdata table

rt_table <- readr::read_csv(
  here("result", "reviewtable_organize", "rt_table.csv")
)


# ============================================== #
# import cleaned species reviewdata table

rt_species <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  here("data", "20261103_ER_reviewtable_cleaning.xlsx"),
  sheet = "dataentry_editing")

colnames(rt_species) <- gsub(" ", "_", colnames(rt_species))

rt_species$Magnitude_of_shift = as.numeric(rt_species$Magnitude_of_shift)


```


# Basic flow

```{r}

# ============================================== #
### create class color list (global)

# Extract unique classes
class_color_table <- data.frame(
  Class = sort(unique(na.omit(rt_species$Class)))
)

# Assign random colors
set.seed(123)

class_color_table$Color <- sample(
  hcl.colors(nrow(class_color_table), palette = "Dark 3")
)

class_palette <- setNames(
  class_color_table$Color,
  class_color_table$Class
)

# ============================================== #
### Define popup function

make_popup <- function(title, fig) {

  # temperately save ggplot as PNG
  img_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = img_file,
    plot = fig,
    width = 10,
    height = 3,
    dpi = 120,
    bg = "white"
  )

  # transfer plot into Base64
  img_src <- base64enc::dataURI(
    file = img_file,
    mime = "image/png"
  )

  unlink(img_file)

  # create HTML popup
  htmltools::HTML(paste0(
    "<div style='width:450px;'>",
    "<h3>", htmltools::htmlEscape(title), "</h3>",
    "<img src='", img_src,
    "' style='width:100%;height:auto;'>",
    "</div>"
  ))
}


# ============================================== #
### Define polygon colors

polygon_colors <- grDevices::hcl.colors(
  length(shp_list),
  palette = "Dark 3"
)


# ============================================== #
### Initialize leaflet map

m_example <- leaflet()  %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  setView(lng = 138.040, lat = 36.140, zoom = 4) %>%
  addMarkers(
    lng = 141.34144193866803,
    lat = 43.070559674088784,
    popup = "Hokudai"
  )



# ============================================== #
### Loop through all study areas

for (i in seq_len(nrow(studyarea2))) {

  # Get current reference number and polygon title
  polygon_title <- ref_i <- as.character(studyarea2$reference_no[i])
  file_i <- as.character(studyarea2$file_final[i])
  
  # Remove .shp extension
  shp_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_i))

  # Find matching polygon in shp_list
  shp_index <- match(
    shp_name,
    tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(names(shp_list)))
  )
  
  # Check if polygon exists
  if (is.na(shp_index)) {
    warning("Polygon not found: ", shp_name)
    next
  }
  
  # Extract polygon directly from shp_list
  shp_i <- shp_list[[shp_index]]
  
  # -------------------------------------------- #
  # Filter species data for current study area

  rt_sp_shp <- rt_species %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Position),
      !is.na(Class),
      !is.na(Magnitude_of_shift),
      Reference_no == ref_i
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Position = as.character(Position),
      Class = as.character(Class)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Position) %>%
    arrange(Magnitude_of_shift, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(bar_id = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()


  # -------------------------------------------- #
  # Generate popup only when data are available

  if (nrow(rt_sp_shp) > 0) {

    # Define Position order
    position_order <- c("Trailing", "Centroid", "Leading")

    positions <- c(
      intersect(position_order, unique(rt_sp_shp$Position)),
      setdiff(unique(rt_sp_shp$Position), position_order)
    )

    # Common Y-axis limits within current study area
    y_limits <- range(c(0, rt_sp_shp$Magnitude_of_shift))

    # Classes appearing in current subset
    used_classes <- sort(
      unique(na.omit(as.character(rt_sp_shp$Class)))
    )

    # Extract colors from global palette
    plot_palette <- class_palette[used_classes]


    # -------------------------------------------- #
    # Define plotting function

    create_shift_plot <- function(pos) {

      data_sub <- rt_sp_shp %>%
        filter(Position == pos)

      ggplot(
        data_sub,
        aes(
          x = bar_id,
          y = Magnitude_of_shift,
          fill = Class
        )
      ) +

        geom_col(
          width = 1,
          show.legend = TRUE
        ) +

        geom_hline(
          yintercept = 0,
          color = "black",
          linewidth = 0.4
        ) +

        scale_fill_manual(
          values = plot_palette,
          limits = used_classes,
          drop = FALSE,
          na.translate = FALSE
        ) +

        scale_x_continuous(
          breaks = NULL,
          expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
        ) +

        scale_y_continuous(
          expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
        ) +

        coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +

        labs(
          title = paste0(pos, ", N = ", nrow(data_sub)),
          x = NULL,
          y = "Latitudinal shift (km/year)",
          fill = "Class"
        ) +

        theme_classic(base_size = 10) +

        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(
            face = "bold",
            size = 11,
            hjust = 0.5
          ),
          axis.line.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "right"
        )
    }


    # -------------------------------------------- #
    # Generate individual plots

    plot_list <- lapply(positions, create_shift_plot)

    names(plot_list) <- positions


    # -------------------------------------------- #
    # Combine plots horizontally

    combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
      plot_list,
      nrow = 1,
      guides = "collect"
    ) &
      theme(
        legend.position = "right"
      )


    # -------------------------------------------- #
    # Create popup for current study area

    popup_i <- make_popup(
      title = polygon_title,
      fig = combined_plot
    )

  } else {

    # Display a message if no valid data exist
    popup_i <- htmltools::HTML(paste0(
      "<div style='width:300px;'>",
      "<h3>", htmltools::htmlEscape(polygon_title), "</h3>",
      "<p>No shift data available for this study area.</p>",
      "</div>"
    ))

  }

 # -------------------------------------------- #
  # Add current polygon and popup to leaflet

  m_example <- m_example %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = shp_i,
      color = polygon_colors[i],
      stroke = TRUE,
      weight = 1,
      opacity = 0.8,
      popup = rep(
        popup_i,
        nrow(shp_i)
      ),
      popupOptions = popupOptions(
        maxWidth = 950
      )
    )

  message(
    "Completed ", i, "/", nrow(studyarea2),
    " : ", polygon_title
  )

}


m_example

```
